biggest_catch: The $25 takes a while: both your account and the new member's account must be open and in good standing for a minimum of 60 days before you earn the deposit, and the new member must present the referral form in a branch.
catches: Complete the New Member Referral Form and give it to family and friends; there is no limit on the number of people you can refer.
Earn a $25 deposit for each person you refer who opens a new membership with a Checking Account.
Both the referring and referred accounts must have been open and in good standing for a minimum of 60 days before the reward is earned.
New member must bring the completed referral form and two forms of ID to a branch to join.
